children.value: Choose how big the toolbar is and where it starts.
Drag the toolbar to a screen edge to dock it there. Top and bottom make it horizontal; left and right make it vertical.

children.help: The toolbar turns into one button after the pointer leaves it, and opens as soon as the pointer is back.
children.label: Shrink preview

children.value: Pick a time in Shrink and the toolbar tucks into one button when you leave it. Point at the button and your tools are back.
